note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. Entities over { id, email?: string, counts: Record<string, number>, lists: Record<string, Array<number>>, tags: Record<string, ReadonlySet<string>> }: Plain, Versioned (versioned: true), Retained (versioned: { retain: true }) and Unique (unique: { byEmail: ['email'] }) with each map configured { storedAs: SparseMap(), field } (counts as 'sr', lists as 'lr', tags as 'tr'); Unrenamed and RetainedUnrenamed with each map { storedAs: SparseMap() }; on DynamoSchema.make({ name: 'ce', version: 1 }). Each case starts from a row put { id: 'a', email: 'e', counts: { a: 1 }, lists: { a: [1, 2] }, tags: { a: {x, y} } } created (for a renamed map: the map whole), or for the renamed maps from one holding them as entries (put with every map {}, then a raw SET counts#a = 1, lists#a = [1, 2], tags#a = {x, y} REMOVE sr, lr, tr) or both (the whole put, then a raw SET counts#a = 7, lists#a = [7], tags#a = {q}), and sends one update clearing a map with clearMap() beside another write to the same map (pathAdd, pathSubtract, pathIfNotExists, a pathSet copy from counts.entry('a'), append, a pathSet, pathAdd or pathRemove below an entry, deleteFromSet, add of a set), standalone or in Transaction.transactWrite. Recorded: its outcome (a result, or a failure's tag and the first line of its message), every request it sent, whole and in order, every row of the table after it, and what get read back. The table's name is replaced by <table>, UUIDs by <token> and timestamps by <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
